note: Locks the gated grid extent. Same module and signal as `particle-ripples`, but the lattice is driven to full height and 60% width instead of the authored one-third band. The gap is set by complexity alone, so this must come out as more rows at the SAME spacing -- if a future change stretches the field to fit instead of adding rows, the particle counts in expected.json move and this fails. Both counts are also parity-checked by ParitySelfTests.testGridExtentParity().
